Create parameter files from the dictionary

Source: R/create_par_files.R
create_par_files.Rd

Writes one par_file CSV per active module (one per group for phytoplankton, zooplankton and fish) containing every dictionary parameter of the selected models, with value set to the dictionary default. Unlike create_calibration_tables, nothing is filtered out: boolean and integer switches (e.g. buoyancy_regulation, nitrogen_fixation, lNfix) and zero-default parameters are all included.

Usage

create_par_files(
  folder = ".",
  config_file,
  folder_out = folder,
  models_coupled = NULL,
  overwrite = FALSE
)

Arguments

folder

path; directory containing the config file.

config_file

character; name of the LakeEnsemblR_WQ YAML config file.

folder_out

path; output directory for the CSV files (created if needed).

models_coupled

character vector; model couplings to include. Defaults to the models listed in the config file.

overwrite

logical; overwrite existing files in folder_out? Defaults to FALSE so edited parameter files are not replaced.

Value

Invisibly returns the paths of the files written.

Details

The files are meant as templates for group- or lake-specific parameter sets: edit value for the parameters to change, delete the rows to leave at their dictionary default, and point the corresponding par_file entry of the LakeEnsemblR_WQ config file at the result. export_config_wq then applies the listed values; the unit, path and note columns are for reference only.

Examples

ex <- lerwq_example()
create_par_files(
  folder         = ex,
  config_file    = "LakeEnsemblR_WQ.yaml",
  folder_out     = file.path(ex, "par_files"),
  models_coupled = "GOTM-Selmaprotbas"
)
#> Created: /tmp/Rtmph9ct1E/lerwq_example/par_files/par_oxygen.csv
#> Created: /tmp/Rtmph9ct1E/lerwq_example/par_files/par_carbon.csv
#> Created: /tmp/Rtmph9ct1E/lerwq_example/par_files/par_nitrogen.csv
#> Created: /tmp/Rtmph9ct1E/lerwq_example/par_files/par_phosphorus.csv
#> Created: /tmp/Rtmph9ct1E/lerwq_example/par_files/par_diatoms.csv
#> Created: /tmp/Rtmph9ct1E/lerwq_example/par_files/par_cyanobacteria.csv
#> Created: /tmp/Rtmph9ct1E/lerwq_example/par_files/par_daphnia.csv
#> 
#> Edit 'value' (and delete rows to keep at dictionary default), then set the par_file entries in LakeEnsemblR_WQ.yaml.
list.files(file.path(ex, "par_files"))
#> [1] "par_carbon.csv"        "par_cyanobacteria.csv" "par_daphnia.csv"      
#> [4] "par_diatoms.csv"       "par_nitrogen.csv"      "par_oxygen.csv"       
#> [7] "par_phosphorus.csv"
